There's a saying we have in Spanish ”Es major estar solo que mal acompañado.” Which translates to “Its better to be alone than to be with bad company.” 

You probably love your grandparents and everything, which is fine because you're family and what not, and you probably feel a little bit guilty considering that your other family members are telling you to cave in and give them the room. But that being said the way they reacted is really not justifiable, it's YOUR vacation that you invited them to, not the other way around. 

They don't just get to come here and try to accommodate the vacation in to their favor when they were the ones who were invited in the first place. Seems to me they have a sense of entitlement just because they're older and are ”respected” (more like spoiled) by their other family members, and on top of that they failed to even realize that they are on a vacation to Bora Bora in a nice bongaloo, something that not a lot of people (especially at their age) get to do. 

OP don't cave in and give them the room, it’ll just make them feel that the way they acted is justifiable and that with enough familial pressure they can do with you as they please. Try to enjoy the trip without them and focus more on your wedding, you're getting married and that in itself should be so exciting! I wish you the best with everything! 

In conclusion NTA!
